newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Senate adopted draft bill on projects related to Romania's nuclear power sector.
* Gouvernment and trade unions will start talks on concrete package of social protection measures.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will meet representatives of the World Bank mission this afternoon. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
